Lenses and mirrors for telescopes are round because the original method of grinding them used two pieces of glass. One was to stick one to a post, and then you put the grinding/polishing compound on it, and held the second piece on top of the first and walked around and around until they took the shape you needed. If you want a square lens, grind the edges until you get a square.

The final lens can be any shape you want so long as you don't remove the curves on the face of the lens that bend and focus the light.
